title: Seek Solitude
coreMove: Choose solitude that has an end, a place, and a purpose: let social noise drop, read one recent miss without blame, then return to people with cleaner attention.

exampleSpecs.audience: people who fear solitude is punishment
exampleSpecs.stakes: use quiet to name one recent miss without exile
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Celia reviews one apology miss and returns to people with a cleaner sentence

exampleSpecs.audience: people who need a short nonperformance pause in a crowd
exampleSpecs.stakes: lower social arousal before the next count
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Andre closes the notebook and restarts from the last clean number

exampleSpecs.audience: people who need quiet enough to feel the task again
exampleSpecs.stakes: let fewer social cues reveal a missed signal
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Soren uses the quiet minute to notice the wind note he missed

exampleSpecs.audience: people seeing the cost of no quiet review
exampleSpecs.stakes: turn attention fatigue into a bounded repair
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Hanna adds one quiet review before the next team talk

exampleSpecs.audience: people whose wish for solitude is sliding into isolation
exampleSpecs.stakes: catch the dodge inside a reasonable sentence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Ilya notices that quiet must send him back to the call

exampleSpecs.audience: people who need solitude with edges
exampleSpecs.stakes: give quiet a time, place, trigger, and error to review
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Mina writes solitude into a repair appointment, not a vague wish
